evals.prompt: 드라이런으로만 보여줘. 로그인 실패 시 사용자가 원인을 확인하고 다시 시도할 수 있도록 안내를 개선하는 Jira 티켓 만들어줘. 담당자는 나야. 기한은 2026-07-31이고 Story Points는 3이야.
evals.expected_output: The skill performs no Jira mutation, asks no follow-up question, infers a standard Task, resolves the explicitly supplied single assignee, uses the due date and 3 Story Points, generates a concise summary and evidence-supported completion criteria, and clearly labels the result as a dry run.
expectations: No Jira mutation is performed because the user requested a dry run.
No follow-up question asks the user to provide purpose, completion criteria, assignee, due date, or Story Points.
The proposed issue type is Task, the only assignee is the authenticated user, the due date is 2026-07-31, and Story Points are 3.
The proposed description contains non-empty purpose, work-content, and completion-criteria sections.
The completion criteria describe observable login-failure guidance and retry behavior without inventing implementation details.

evals.prompt: $jira-create-ticket. 실제 Jira에는 쓰지 말고, 정보가 부족할 때 어떤 질문을 하는지만 보여줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill performs no Jira mutation and asks exactly one compact question requesting the work, exactly one assignee, a due date, and Story Points from 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8. It does not present a form or separately ask for completion criteria.
expectations: No Jira mutation is performed.
Exactly one compact clarification question is shown.
The question asks what work to register.
Exactly one assignee, due date, and Story Points from the allowed scale are requested in the same compact question.
Purpose, completion criteria, priority, labels, sprint, environment, and implementation details are not requested as separate inputs.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 S15P11B104-84의 MVP 범위 설정을 팀 전체 공동 작업으로 나누는 과정을 보여줘. 신규 하위 작업은 만들지 말고, 각 결과별 담당자는 한 명, 기한은 2026-07-31, Story Points는 각각 3 이하로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses read-only Jira discovery, resolves S15P11B104-84, proposes independently completable standard tickets with one assignee each, uses the same Epic or explicit issue links, assigns an allowed Story Points value only where the user supplied enough explicit estimates, and creates no subtask or Jira mutation.
expectations: S15P11B104-84 is fetched and verified before proposing relationships.
No new subtask is proposed.
Each proposed standard ticket has one assignee and an independently completable result.
The common due date 2026-07-31 is proposed for every standard ticket.
Every Story Points value uses 1, 2, or 3 and is not silently inferred when the request lacks a per-ticket estimate.
The tickets use the same Epic or supported Blocks/Relates relationships instead of a subtask parent.
Each proposed ticket has a non-empty generated description and completion criteria.
No role-specific scope, metrics, deadlines, or technical requirements are invented without support from the request or parent issue.
No Jira mutation is performed because the user requested a dry run.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 중복 판단만 보여줘. 내가 요청한 작업과 목적, 범위, 완료 기준이 같은 미완료 티켓이 이미 있지만 기존 담당자와 Story Points는 이번 요청과 달라.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the existing unfinished issue as the same work despite different assignee or Story Points, reports the existing issue and field discrepancies, and proposes no duplicate creation or existing-issue edit.
expectations: The duplicate decision is based on purpose, scope, completion result, relationship, and unfinished state.
Different assignee or Story Points do not make otherwise identical work a separate ticket.
The existing issue and differing attributes are reported.
No duplicate ticket or subtask is proposed.
No existing issue is edited and no Jira mutation occurs in the dry run.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 S15P11B104-11 에픽에 '보호자는 통화 리포트를 조회할 수 있다' 스토리와 FE·BE·AI 구현 작업을 나눠줘. 스토리 DRI와 FE는 나, BE는 손수호, AI는 이종철이고, 공통 기한은 2026-08-05야. 스토리는 5점, 각 작업은 3점이야.
evals.expected_output: The skill proposes one domain-neutral user-value Story and three independently completable prefixed Tasks, with one assignee and required fields each, all in the same Epic and each Task related to the Story, without creating anything.
expectations: Exactly one domain-neutral Story is proposed for the shared user value.
The Story is not cloned as `[FE]`, `[BE]`, or `[AI]` Stories.
The implementation units are proposed as `[FE]`, `[BE]`, and `[AI]` Tasks with distinct observable completion results.
Every proposed issue has exactly one assignee, due date 2026-08-05, and the supplied Story Points.
All issues use Epic S15P11B104-11 and each technical Task uses `Relates` to the Story; `Blocks` is used only if an actual dependency is identified.
No Jira mutation occurs because the request is a dry run.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 서로 다른 사용자 가치를 가진 두 스토리를 제안해줘. 하나는 '[FE] 보호자는 통화 중 실시간 자막을 볼 수 있다', 다른 하나는 '[AI] 보호자는 통화 후 요약을 확인할 수 있다'야. 둘 다 담당자는 나, 기한은 2026-08-06, Story Points는 5로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill permits the two prefixed Stories because each expresses a distinct user-visible value and independent acceptance result, without treating the prefixes as issue types.
expectations: Both proposed issues remain Stories because their issue type comes from the requested user value, not the prefixes.
The distinct user-visible value and observable acceptance result are verified for each Story.
The two Stories are not treated as ownership-only clones of one shared Story.
No Jira mutation occurs because the request is a dry run.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 두 작업을 제안해줘. FE와 BE가 함께 쓰는 API 계약 생성 기반 작업은 '[COMMON]'으로, 중간발표 자료 정리는 영역 분할과 무관한 단일 작업으로 만들어줘. 둘 다 담당자는 나, 기한은 2026-08-07, Story Points는 2야.
evals.expected_output: The skill prefixes the shared technical foundation with `[COMMON]` and leaves the standalone presentation Task unprefixed.
expectations: `[COMMON]` is used only for the foundation shared by FE and BE.
The standalone presentation Task receives no domain prefix.
Neither issue is converted into a Story or subtask.
No Jira mutation occurs because the request is a dry run.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 '[COMMON] 보호자는 가족 리포트를 확인할 수 있다'라는 스토리를 만들어줘. 담당자는 나, 기한은 2026-08-08, Story Points는 5야.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects `[COMMON]` as a Story prefix and asks for the minimum correction without creating or silently changing the issue.
expectations: `[COMMON]` is identified as a shared-foundation Task prefix, not a Story prefix.
The skill does not silently create a `[COMMON]` Story or reinterpret it as a Task.
No Jira mutation occurs in the dry run.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 같은 '보호자는 통화 리포트를 조회할 수 있다' 사용자 가치를 `[FE]`, `[BE]`, `[AI]` 스토리 세 개로 복제해줘. 담당자는 모두 나, 기한은 2026-08-08, 각 3점이야.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects ownership-only Story cloning and asks whether to keep one shared Story with prefixed technical Tasks.
expectations: The three titles are recognized as one shared user value rather than distinct Stories.
No ownership-only prefixed Stories are proposed.
One compact correction question offers one shared Story plus prefixed Tasks.
The skill does not silently convert issue types or relationships.

evals.prompt: 드라이런으로 '[FE] 중간발표 자료 정리' 작업을 만들어줘. 영역 분할과 무관한 단일 작업이고 담당자는 나, 기한은 2026-08-08, Story Points는 2야.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the unnecessary standalone prefix and asks whether the Task should remain unprefixed or is actually a technical split from a shared Story.
expectations: A standalone presentation Task is recognized as requiring no domain prefix.
The requested `[FE]` is not silently retained or stripped.
One compact correction question resolves the issue role before any proposed creation.
